why: Both analyses land on the same hedgehog (branded paper-based consumer products, profit per consumer brand) and flag missing segment data with marked assumptions, but Analysis 2 commits outright to selling the mills, including the namesake mill, and names the inability to fund both mill modernization and a fight with Rival P as the most urgent brutal fact. Analysis 1 hedges the mill exit as a capex freeze pending return-on-capital data, which makes its verdict less decisive and further from the key's stop-doing decision.
